snippets.description: Registration FilePond once per application: factory vue-filepond + plugins (validate-type/size, image-preview, file-poster) + CSS core and plugins; options published-package and local wrapper

Reused loading field: server-config laravel-filepond (process/revert/patch on /filepond, CSRF), v-model list { id?, serverId? }, restoration of saved files by posters, linking serverId on processfile/removefile
Linking the list of downloaded files to Inertia-form (useForm) and server processing: route /filepond, callbacks process/revert/patch/restore, Filepond::field($serverId)->getFile()->binding to model
